Item 1A.
Risk Factors

We face intense competition across retail, e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and consumer hardware devices.

Our rapid expansion of fulfillment and distribution centers places significant demands on our operational systems and personnel.

Disruptions in our cloud computing platform (AWS) could result in financial liability and loss of customer confidence across critical sectors.
